definitions.explanation: A place of confinement for prisoners. Has a somewhat literary or historical flavor compared to the more modern {刑務所|けいむしょ}. Often evokes images of traditional or historical prisons with bars and dungeons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{罪人|ざいにん}→罪人：13984_zainin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{牢|ろう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れられた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: The criminal was thrown into prison.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十年間|じゅうねんかん}{牢|ろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: He spent ten years in prison.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無実|むじつ}→無実：09504_mujitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{牢|ろう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れられた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{助|たす}け→助け：07777_tasuke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{脱獄|だつごく}→脱獄：15732_datsugoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧。
examples.english: The novel's protagonist was imprisoned on a false charge but succeeded in escaping with the help of his companions.

notes:
USAGE:
More literary and evocative than ⟦{刑務所|けいむしょ}→刑務所：19074_keimusho⟧ (prison, penitentiary) or ⟦{留置場|りゅうちじょう}→留置場：30444_ryuuchijou⟧ (detention center). Frequently appears in historical fiction, fantasy, and dramatic contexts. In everyday conversation about the modern justice system, ⟦{刑務所|けいむしょ}→刑務所：19074_keimusho⟧ is preferred.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{牢屋|ろうや}→牢屋：15832_rouya⟧: prison, jail cell (more colloquial)
- ⟦{牢獄|ろうごく}→牢獄：25940_rougoku⟧: prison, dungeon (literary)
- {入牢|にゅうろう}: imprisonment (historical)
- {脱牢|だつろう}: prison break (historical)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牢|ろう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: put in prison
- {牢|ろう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: get out of prison
- {牢|ろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: inside the prison
